benchmark.name: FIFA World Cup 2026 Live Sports Freshness Benchmark
benchmark.task: Retrieve fresh information about 50 live FIFA World Cup 2026 queries across match results, standings, scorers, controversies, rules, Asian teams, news, stats, and betting
benchmark.dataset: 50 hand-curated queries from live FIFA World Cup 2026 coverage (June 11-21, 2026) across 9 categories
benchmark.setup: Each query sent to 5 web search APIs via KrabArena Battle Proxy. All responses flattened to max 7000 chars using generic recursive text extraction (same method for all APIs). GPT-4o-mini (temperature=0) judges whether flattened context contains sufficient fresh information. Sorted by % sufficient, then quality, then latency. Region: US-West. Date: 2026-06-21.

leaderboard.notes: Perfect 3.0/3.0, 100% sufficient across all 50 queries and 9 categories. Fastest at 628ms, cheapest at $1/1K.
